info.title: AI矿策新项目API建议基线
info.description: 设计契约，不是已运行服务。public/private按独立origin暴露。所有示例为合成。

get.description: id accepts returned request_id or caller Idempotency-Key; lookup is actor scoped.

SourceConfig.description: id is profile_id; source_id is publisher-source identity. State and lane belong to this profile.

SourceAction.description: Target path id is profile_id. Only this profile/lane is affected.

ReviewRequest.description: Missing correction field means unchanged; clear_fields explicitly clears permitted optional fields. Same field in both is 400. Empty title is rejected by command rules.
